Rene will always be that little boy you brought into this world. the child you carried in your womb, held in your arms, watched grow, and loved with every piece of your heart. No matter how many years pass, no matter how much the world changes, he will always be your son.

You may no longer be able to hold him in your arms, but you will carry him in your heart for the rest of your life. Because the love of a mother for the child she brought into this world does not end with a goodbye. It does not end with death. IT LIVES ON, BEYOND DEATH! 😭
